question: On Sunday review: is n enough and net clear enough to recommend a Brad letter GO on one arm (A / C / AC), or keep shadow?

verdicts.N_INSUFFICIENT: Keep shadow. Collect more ballast/core would-arm legs. No letter GO.
verdicts.SIGNAL_THIN: n ok-ish but net/median/dominance fail — keep shadow; do not promote on one ETH ghost.
verdicts.READY_FOR_LETTER_GO: Gates pass on primary board. Recommend letter GO on winner arm only — still no auto flip.
verdicts.BLOCKED_LIVE_FLAG: Policy or config live_apply true unexpectedly — stop and audit before any GO.

do_not: Flip live_apply without explicit Brad letter GO naming the arm
Promote on all-legs board when would-arm n is thin
Apply A/C to tryout shells via this path
